evidence.expiry: 『Compound patent expiry in the US for the semaglutide branded products - Ozempic, Rybelsus, and Wegovy - is 2032』+『The compound patent for Victoza has expired...The drug compound patent for Saxenda (liraglutide) has expired in all countries』→主力semaglutideは2032年特許崖・旧世代はバイオシミラー既出=期限型独占→yes
evidence.moatdecay: 『due to increased competition in both US and ex-US markets, Novo Nordisk has lost volume market share in the GLP-1 market places for both obesity and diabetes』+2032特許崖+『pricing pressure is expected to continue』→堀は縮小方向=yes
evidence.erosion: 『Novo Nordisk has lost volume market share in the GLP-1 market places for both obesity and diabetes』『average prices after rebates for the Novo Nordisk portfolio in 2025 in the United States declined』→現在進行の侵食=active
evidence.disrupt: 蝕セクションに技術代替のキーワードヒットなし。ただし『Novo Nordisk and Eli Lilly are the most significant companies...measured by market share』の二強競争が激化(シェア喪失・価格低下)。カテゴリー自体は成長継続だが競争構図流動的→unsettled
evidence.dom: 『Novo Nordisk and Eli Lilly are the most significant companies measured by market share』=GLP-1二強寡占(NVO単独シェアはLillyとの二分へ低下中)。『Obesity and Diabetes care...comprising more than 90% of sales』は売上構成であってシェアではない→寡占40-69%=70
evidence.irr_rep: 『a compound must first be proven to work by means of multiple clinical trials, which may require treatment of thousands of patients and could take years to complete』+『sustain strong patent protection』=複製は数年/$10B級で極困難→rep80。ただしLillyのtirzepatide等の代替が現存し患者移行可能→irr70(高摩擦だが唯一供給ではない)
evidence.dur: 特許(規制)+ペプチド大量製造のプロセス知(『there have been periodic supply constraints for certain products』が製造障壁の傍証)→規制/プロセス型の高堀。ただしLillyが同機序を実装済で絶対的スイッチングロックではない→85
evidence.geopol: 『pricing pressure is expected to continue in the future, driven by: increasing rebates in the commercial segment, the effect of payer consolidation』+『recognise revenue of USD 4.2 billion comprising the entire amount of provisions for 340B statutory discounts』=米薬価政策(IRA/340B/関税圧力)が中核フランチャイズに集中。ただし地理は米/EUCAN/EM/APAC/中国に分散→中=1
evidence.p1: ROIC5年σ=10.3pt(二桁)だが低下はIC急拡大(Catalent+設備投資)主因でopm41-44%安定→55
evidence.p2: 『revenue for the GLP-1 product Wegovy grew 36%』糖尿/肥満は非景気循環需要。2020 COVID期も営利52.5→54.1十億で増加=不況で営利低下せず→95
evidence.p4: accr=-3.1%(<0・OCF>NI=保守的)。『material weakness』ヒットは監査手続の定型記述で実指摘ではない。『ITEM 4A UNRESOLVED STAFF COMMENTS None』→90
evidence.f1: ROIIC 2023→25≒10%/2022→24≒30%(直近は前収益の製造能力投資で圧縮)+再投資率≥30%→65
evidence.f2: 『The growth in the number of people with obesity and diabetes and the increasing use of the GLP-1 drug category is driving』『expected to grow in the coming decades』=GLP-1の肥満TAM浸透は一桁%→85
evidence.f3: R&D『modestly expand upon the current expenditure level of around 15-17% of sales in research and development』(R&D対売上+)対『lost volume market share』(シェア−)=片方符号→75
evidence.f4: 中核が売上90%超(『more than 90% of sales』)。隣接の希少疾患/血友病(Concizumab/Alhemo新規承認)は5%超だが成長寄与は限定・育成段階→60
evidence.roicg: 機械算出 2025年: NOPAT ÷ (自己資本 194,047,000,000 + 有利子負債 130,958,000,000)＝のれん込み。roic(除外)との差が買収規律の指標
evidence.roict: 機械算出: のれん除外ROIC 5年系列 48.7% / 55.0% / 61.4% / 44.1% / 32.8%（最古→直近の差で判定）
evidence.gmt: 機械算出: 営業利益率 2023年 44.2% → 2025年 41.3%（±1ptでup/down）
